overview.headline: Weight as gravitational force decreasing slightly with altitude

keyPoints.point: Weight is the force caused by Earth gravitational attraction on an object
keyPoints.quote: Weight is the force generated by the gravitational attraction of the earth on any object.

keyPoints.point: Aerodynamic forces are mechanical and need physical contact with air
keyPoints.quote: Aerodynamic forces are mechanical forces and the object has to be in physical contact with the air which generates the force.

keyPoints.point: Surface value is given in meters and feet per square second
keyPoints.quote: On the surface of the earth, its value is 9.8 meters per square second or 32.2 feet per square second.

keyPoints.point: Airplane weighs show small loss in pounds compared to surface amount
keyPoints.quote: it weighs 9965 pounds at 35000 feet; it has lost 35 pounds, a very small amount compared to 10000 pounds.

keyTerms.gloss: Force from gravitational attraction of Earth
keyTerms.quote: Weight is the force generated by the gravitational attraction of the earth on any object.

keyTerms.gloss: Field force acting without physical contact
keyTerms.quote: The gravitational force is a field force; the source of the force does not have to be in physical contact with the object to generate a force.
Weight is fundamentally different from the aerodynamic forces, lift and drag.

keyTerms.gloss: Combined acceleration from gravity used with mass for weight
keyTerms.quote: The weight W, or gravitational force, is then just the mass of an object times the gravitational acceleration.

analysis.pageCoverage: Page explains weight as Earth gravitational force, defines universal gravitation and surface acceleration, gives weight equation and altitude example.
